schema_note: Chapter-local review-queue candidates only. This file is NOT the global research/scope/review_queue.json - it is merged into that coordinator-maintained file after this chapter passes validation.

items.title: GY.S01 printed title 'Acromyms' is a non-substantive acronym list; merged_duplicate_headings gives the usable alternate 'Basic Anatomy Review'
items.summary: The section's printed TOC title names a front-matter acronym list rather than a clinical topic. The legible merged_duplicate_headings alternate ('Basic Anatomy Review') is used as the study-unit title instead, consistent with the section's likely front-of-chapter position.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - represented as SU-GY-01 using the merged alternate title.

items.title: GY.S04 ('Disorders of Menstruation') carries two additional distinct diagnoses (Endometriosis, Adenomyosis) not represented as their own TOC nodes
items.summary: The section's merged_duplicate_headings field records 'Endometriosis' and 'Adenomyosis' alongside its three normal T-children (Amenorrhea, AUB, Dysmenorrhea). Both are clinically distinct diagnoses, not alternate labels for existing T-child content, so each was split into its own study unit cited against the parent section node (no dedicated child node exists for either).
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - represented as SU-GY-08 (Endometriosis) and SU-GY-09 (Adenomyosis); recommend confirming against raw source/body text in a later pass since no independent OCR corpus was available here.

items.title: GY.S05's printed title 'Fibroids' conflicts with all three of its own T-children, which are unambiguously Contraception subtopics
items.summary: Printed title 'Fibroids' (body-heading-confirmed) does not match any of its T-children (Hormonal Methods, IUD, Emergency Postcoital Contraception), all of which match the section's merged_duplicate_headings entry 'Contraception'. Targeted raw-OCR follow-up (2026-08-25) resolved this: pdf pages 608-609 (TN GY14-GY15) carry genuine, standalone Fibroids content (Definition/Epidemiology/Pathogenesis/Management) ending where a body-confirmed 'Contraception' heading begins mid-page-609. GY.S05 merges two real adjacent sections rather than mis-extracting one.
items.resolution_status: RESOLVED - represented as SU-GY-10 (Contraception, pdf 609-612, unchanged) and SU-GY-40 (Fibroids/uterine leiomyoma, pdf 608-609, added after raw-source verification; see study_units_audit.json's resolved_coverage_gaps).

items.title: GY.S12's printed title 'SexualAbuse' bundles two clinically distinct topics with its merged heading 'Sexuality and Sexual Dysfunction'
items.summary: Unlike single-topic title/merged-heading pairs elsewhere in this chapter, GY.S12's two titles name genuinely different content (forensic sexual abuse/assault vs. clinical sexual dysfunction). Split into two study units, both cited against the shared parent node since no distinct child nodes exist for either half.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - represented as SU-GY-22 (Sexual Abuse and Assault) and SU-GY-23 (Sexual Dysfunction).

items.title: GY.S18's printed title 'References' is a structural mislabel - its T-children are real clinical content, not a bibliography
items.summary: Unlike the genuine terminal References sections in every other completed chapter, GY.S18's four T-children (Menstrual Cycle, Stages of Puberty, Premenstrual Syndrome, Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder) are real appendix-style clinical content. Each is represented under its own real topic instead of being classified as bibliographic REFERENCE_ONLY material.
items.resolution_status: INDEPENDENTLY RESOLVED - Menstrual Cycle consolidated into SU-GY-02 (with GY.S02), Stages of Puberty as SU-GY-38, PMS+PMDD consolidated into SU-GY-39.

items.title: Pregnancy-related content (Termination of Pregnancy, Early Pregnancy Loss/First-Trimester Bleeding, Ectopic Pregnancy) genuinely appears in the GY chapter TOC
items.summary: All three units cover content that could conceptually belong to Obstetrics, but each is a genuine GY-chapter source node (GY.S06, GY.S07, GY.S08) and was therefore mapped here per the instruction against moving genuine chapter content out of GY. Final PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK/DISTINCT_CONTEXT decisions against the OB chapter (not yet mapped) are deferred.
items.resolution_status: DEFERRED - flagged for the global GY/OB boundary audit once OB is mapped, per instructions not to finalize ownership now.

items.title: Candidate cross-discipline overlaps requiring later global resolution
items.summary: SU-GY-15 (PCOS) may overlap Endocrinology (E, completed). SU-GY-17 (STI) may overlap Infectious Diseases and Public Health (both not yet mapped). SU-GY-21 (Surgical Site Infections) may overlap General and Thoracic Surgery (GS, completed). SU-GY-27 (Urinary Incontinence) may overlap Urology (not yet mapped). All four are recorded here as candidate PRIMARY_OWNER/CROSS_LINK pairs; none is finalized.
items.resolution_status: DEFERRED - flagged for the global chapter-overlap audit once all chapters mapping the same content are complete.

items.title: Termination of Pregnancy and Sexual Abuse/Assault carry provincial/territorial jurisdiction-sensitive content
items.summary: Both units' freshness/jurisdiction metadata flag LEGAL_REGULATORY verification and PROVINCIAL_TERRITORIAL scope (abortion access/gestational limits; mandatory-reporting and forensic-examination protocols). Neither hard-codes a specific province's rule, per the schema's jurisdiction fields and the instruction not to convert province-specific rules into national ones. Both also touch content ELOM (completed) may partly own at a more general level (consent; abuse reporting).
items.resolution_status: DEFERRED - jurisdiction/freshness metadata recorded; final ELOM/GY DISTINCT_CONTEXT ownership not resolved here, per instructions.

items.title: Two study units have no adequate MCC objective evidence (Bartholin Gland Abscess, Gynecologic Surgical Site Infections)
items.summary: Targeted search-mcc-objectives queries (bartholin gland, toxic shock syndrome, surgical infection) returned zero or clearly-unrelated matches for these two presentations. Rather than fabricate objectives or force a citation onto unrelated evidence, both units were classified UNCERTAIN with zero planned question coverage and a documented uncertain_reason.
items.resolution_status: RESOLVED PER ACCURACY RULES - no evidence fabricated; revisit only if a future MCC objectives-registry refresh adds relevant objectives.
